english: Sign in to your student account
kiswahili: Ingia kwenye akaunti yako ya mwanafunzi
translation: Chut eng akaunti ngung ab kipsomaniat
back_translation: Ingia kwenye akaunti yako ya wanafunzi

english: Manage the testimonials on the home page
kiswahili: Simamia shuhuda kwenye ukurasa wa mwanzo

english: Plan your studies abroad with people who walk you through every step.
kiswahili: Panga masomo yako nje ya nchi na watu wanaokuongoza kila hatua.
translation: Pangan somanet ngung eng sang ak biik che toretun eng hatua tugul.
back_translation: Panga masomo yako nje na wale watakaokusaidia kila hatua.

english: We take you from choosing a course to applying, preparing for your English test and getting your visa for the UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Ireland and New Zealand. A dedicated team in our Eldoret office handles each step, so you always know who is looking after you.
kiswahili: Tunakusaidia kuanzia kuchagua kozi hadi kutuma maombi, kujiandaa kwa mtihani wako wa Kiingereza na kupata visa yako ya Uingereza, Kanada, Australia, Ujerumani, Ayalandi na New Zealand. Timu maalum katika ofisi yetu ya Eldoret hushughulikia kila hatua, ili ujue kila wakati ni nani anayekuhudumia.
translation: Timit nyonet ko toretin kolewen kosit, kosom eng sukulisiek, ak konyor visa chebo Uingereza, Kanada, Australia, Ujerumani, Ayalandi ak New Zealand. Hatua age age ko tinye timit nyin eng ofisit nyonet eng Eldoret.
back_translation: Timu yetu ni ya kusaidika kuchagua rasilimali, kusoma, na kupata visa za Uingereza, Kanada, Germany, Ayaland na New Zealand. Hatua nyingine ni timu yake iko katika ofisi yetu huko Eldoret.
Nafsi yako inakuinua, lakini bado ninakuinua.

english: Six steps from your first meeting with us, at our Eldoret office or online, to your first day abroad, each handled by its own team.
kiswahili: Hatua sita kuanzia mkutano wako wa kwanza nasi, katika ofisi yetu ya Eldoret au mtandaoni, hadi siku yako ya kwanza ughaibuni, kila moja ikishughulikiwa na timu yake.
translation: Hatua loo ne kongete tuiyet ne kotau ak kityo, eng ofisit nyonet eng Eldoret anan eng online, koi eng kasit ne kotau eng sang, hatua age age ko tinye timit nyin.
back_translation: Namna kumi tangu mkutano wa kwanza kuwepo, iwe ofisini yetu huko Eldoret au mtandaoni, ni bora katika mradi wa nje, hatua nyingine ni na timu yake.

english: See every step and who looks after it
translation: Ker hatua tugul ak chii ne toreti
back_translation: Angalia kila hatua na mtu anayekusaidia.

kiswahili: ORODHA YA KUSOMA NJE YA NCHI

english: Talk to us about your grades, budget and goals, at our office in Eldoret or online. Your first consultation is free.
kiswahili: Zungumza nasi kuhusu alama zako, bajeti na malengo yako, katika ofisi yetu Eldoret au mtandaoni. Ushauri wako wa kwanza ni bure.
draft_not_used: Ngalal ak kityo agobo tiemutik ngung, bajetit ak panganet ngung, eng ofisit nyonet eng Eldoret anan online. Kotigonet ne taun ko eng puch.
back_translation: Ongea na tu kuhusu mtihani wako, bajeti na mpango wako, katika ofisi yetu huko Eldoret au mtandaoni. Ushauri wa kwanza ulikuwa bure.

english: IELTS, PTE or German, in class during the day or online in the evening. Already sat IELTS elsewhere? You go straight to documentation.
kiswahili: IELTS, PTE au Kijerumani, darasani wakati wa mchana au mtandaoni jioni. Tayari ulifanya IELTS mahali pengine? Unaruka moja kwa moja hadi nyaraka.
translation: IELTS, PTE anan Kijerumani, eng sukul eng mchana anan online eng amitwokik. Kasomanchi IELTS eng ole age? Iwendi kwa moja eng karatasishek.
back_translation: IELTS, PTE au Kijerumani, shuleni kwa muda mfupi au mtandaoni kwa chakula. Nimesoma IELTS mahali pengine? Nenda moja kwa moja kwenye karatasi.

english: We tell you exactly which documents you need, certified by a lawyer and clearly scanned.
kiswahili: Tunakuambia hasa nyaraka unazohitaji, zikiwa zimethibitishwa na wakili na kuskaniwa vizuri.
draft_not_used: Kimwochi karatasishek ne imache, kikoito okilot ak kipikchaito mising.
back_translation: Alimwambia karatasi uliyotaka, alimpa wakili na kipikaji zaidi.

english: Every certificate and bank statement is confirmed with whoever issued it.
kiswahili: Kila cheti na taarifa ya benki huthibitishwa na aliyekitoa.
translation: Sertifiketishek tugul ak statementishek ab benkit ko kikonunet ak chii ne kityoi.
back_translation: Hati zote na taarifa za benki zilitolewa kwa mteja.

english: We choose your course and school with you, apply, meet the offer’s conditions and get your confirmation of enrolment.
kiswahili: Tunachagua kozi na shule yako pamoja nawe, tunatuma maombi, tunatimiza masharti ya ofa na kupata uthibitisho wako wa kujiandikisha.
translation: Kilewen kosit ak sukul ngung ak iyon, kitumi aplikesheni, kiyai ng'alek che meche ofa ak konyor confirmation ab enrolment.
back_translation: Ulichagua kozi na shule yako na kisha, ulitumia app hii, ukatatua mahitaji yako na kupata uthibitisho wa enrolment.

english: Health cover, medical examination and biometrics bookings, your visa application entered and audited, then a discounted student flight.
kiswahili: Bima ya afya, uchunguzi wa kimatibabu na miadi ya alama za vidole, ombi lako la visa kujazwa na kukaguliwa, kisha tiketi ya ndege ya wanafunzi kwa bei nafuu.
translation: Bima ab afya, tiemutik ab kanyoishet ak biometrics, aplikesheni ab visa ngung kokoit ak konunet, ak tiketi ab ndegeit ab kipsomaninik eng olyet ne kararan.
back_translation: Bima za afya, mitihani ya matibabu na biometrics, kuomba visa yako baadaye na kuhitimu, na tikiti ya ndege ya wanafunzi kwa bei ya juu na ya juu.

english: We help you access quality education in top destinations around the world. Choose from a wide range of countries, universities and programs.
kiswahili: Tunakusaidia kupata elimu bora katika nchi zinazoongoza duniani. Chagua kutoka nchi, vyuo vikuu na programu mbalimbali.
translation: Kitoretun konyor somanet ne kararan eng emotinwek ne kararan eng ng'ony. Lewen eng emotinwek, sukulisiek ak programishek chechang.
back_translation: Imesaidia kupata elimu bora katika nchi bora duniani. Chagua katika nchi, shule na programu nyingi.

english: World-class universities and a relaxed, multicultural lifestyle.
kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vya hadhi ya dunia na maisha tulivu ya tamaduni mbalimbali.
draft_not_used: Sukulisiek che kararan eng ng'ony ak sobet ne kararan ab biik che chang.
back_translation: Shule bora duniani na maisha bora kwa watu wengi.

english: Respected colleges and universities in a safe, welcoming, multicultural country.
kiswahili: Vyuo na vyuo vikuu vinavyoheshimika katika nchi salama, ya kukaribisha na yenye tamaduni nyingi.
translation: Sukulisiek ne cheng'engung eng emet ne kalyet, ne kararan ak ne miten biik che chang.
back_translation: Shule za msingi ni za wewe katika nchi yenye amani, nzuri na watu wengi.

english: Tuition-friendly public universities. Our language training gets you ready.
kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vya umma vyenye ada nafuu. Mafunzo yetu ya lugha yanakuandaa.
draft_not_used: Sukulisiek ab Serikali ne Matinye Robinik che Chang'. Ineeti Kutit Kityo si Kobwat Kogoi.
back_translation: Shule za serikali hawana pesa nyingi. Inafundisha lugha kidogo kufikiria zaidi.

kiswahili: Kwa nini uchague Studies and Awards
translation: Amu nee ko kilewen Studies and Awards
back_translation: Kwa nini alichagua Studies and Awards?

english: One consultancy, every step of the journey.
kiswahili: Kampuni moja ya ushauri, kila hatua ya safari.
translation: Timit age, hatua tugul ab rutoi.
back_translation: Timu nyingine, kila hatua ya safari.

english: Studies and Awards Limited is an educational consultancy based in Eldoret, Kenya, working with students from all over the country. We help students choose the right course and country, prepare for English tests, apply to schools, get their visas and travel.
kiswahili: Studies and Awards Limited ni kampuni ya ushauri wa elimu yenye makao Eldoret, Kenya, inayofanya kazi na wanafunzi kutoka kote nchini. Tunawasaidia wanafunzi kuchagua kozi na nchi sahihi, kujiandaa kwa mitihani ya Kiingereza, kutuma maombi shuleni, kupata visa na kusafiri.
translation: Studies and Awards Limited ko kampunit ab ngalalet ab somanet ne mi eng Eldoret, Kenya, ne boisie ak kipsomaninik eng emet tugul. Kitoretun kipsomaninik lewen kosit ak emet ne kararan, pangan tiemutik ab kutit tab chumbek, tum aplikesheni eng sukul, konyor visa ak rutoi.
back_translation: Studies and Awards Limited ni kampuni ya mawasiliano ya masomo iliyoko Eldoret, Kenya, inayotumika na wanafunzi kote nchini. Itasaidia wanafunzi kuchagua ajira na nchi nzuri, kupanga mitihani ya Kiingereza, kusafiri mapema shuleni, kupata visa na ziara.

english: To facilitate access to quality education abroad for Kenyan students, ensuring affordability, transparency, and personalised support throughout their academic journey.
kiswahili: Kuwezesha upatikanaji wa elimu bora ughaibuni kwa wanafunzi wa Kenya, kuhakikisha unafuu, uwazi na usaidizi wa kibinafsi katika safari yao yote ya masomo.
translation: Toret kipsomaninik ab Kenya konyor somanet ne kararan eng sang, kinyoru olyet ne kararan, kimwochi ngalek ne iman ak toretet ne tinye chii eng rutoi ab somanet.
back_translation: Wanafunzi wa Kenya wanasaidiwa kupata elimu bora nje, bei nzuri, ushauri wa kweli na usaidizi wa watu kwenye safari ya kimasomo.

draft_not_used: Konyoret ne Kararan ak Olyet ne Kararan

english: Affordable options so cost does not stand in the way of education.
kiswahili: Chaguo nafuu ili gharama isiwe kikwazo cha elimu.
draft_not_used: Olyet ne kararan kole matinye robinik ko kobo somanet.
back_translation: Ni vizuri kusema kuwa kukosa pesa kunategemea elimu.

english: Keeping up with new trends, tools and best practice in international education.
kiswahili: Kufuatilia mielekeo mipya, zana na mbinu bora katika elimu ya kimataifa.
translation: Kibwat tuguk che lel eng somanet ab ng'ony ak kiboisiee oret ne kararan.
back_translation: Aliwaza mambo mapya katika masomo ya ulimwengu na kutumia mbinu nzuri.

draft_not_used: Aplikesheni ak Konunet ne Matinye Chorset
back_translation: Ninacheza kwa zawadi isiyo na wizi

english: Rigorous checks that protect students and partners alike.
kiswahili: Ukaguzi mkali unaowalinda wanafunzi na washirika kwa pamoja.
draft_not_used: Konunet ne kalyet ne kalyet kipsomaninik ak koborotik.
back_translation: Mtaala wa usalama kwa wanfunzi na wananchi.

english: Studied abroad with us? Share your story
kiswahili: Ulisoma ughaibuni kupitia sisi? Shiriki hadithi yako
draft_not_used: Kisomanchi eng sang ak kityo? Kwen ngalek ngung
back_translation: Usilisomea nje tu? Sema maneno yako

english: The questions students and parents ask us most. Anything else, call us on +254 721 796500.
kiswahili: Maswali tunayoulizwa zaidi na wanafunzi na wazazi. Kwa jingine lolote, tupigie kwa +254 721 796500.
translation: Tebutik che kitebuti kipsomaninik ak sigik. Eng ole age, pirchin kityo eng +254 721 796500.
back_translation: Maswali haya waliyatoa wanafunzi na wazazi kwa upande mwingine yanaweza kushughulikiwa kwa njia ya +254 721 796500.

english: Do you offer IELTS and PTE classes?
kiswahili: Je, mnatoa madarasa ya IELTS na PTE?
translation: Tos tinyei Studies and Awards sukulisiek ab IELTS ak PTE?
back_translation: Je, vyuo vikuu vya IELTS na PTE vina masomo au tuzo?

english: Yes. Our trainers teach IELTS and PTE in person and online, and we can also register you for the exam.
kiswahili: Ndiyo. Wakufunzi wetu hufundisha IELTS na PTE ana kwa ana na mtandaoni, na tunaweza pia kukusajili kwa mtihani.
translation: Ee. Konetik nyonet ko ineti IELTS ak PTE eng sukul ak online, ak kitos kosajili eng tiemutik.
back_translation: Naam, walimu wetu hufundisha IELTS na PTE shuleni na mtandaoni, na tayari wamejiandikisha kwenye mitihani.

english: Can you help me with my visa?
kiswahili: Je, mnaweza kunisaidia na visa yangu?

english: Yes. Our visa team arranges your health cover, books your medical examination and biometrics appointment, fills in your visa application for you and audits it before it is submitted.
kiswahili: Ndiyo. Timu yetu ya visa hupanga bima yako ya afya, huweka miadi ya uchunguzi wa kimatibabu na alama za vidole, hujaza ombi lako la visa na kulikagua kabla halijawasilishwa.
translation: Ee. Timit nyonet ab visa ko kipang bima ab afya ngung, kikeriye tiemutik ab kanyoishet ak biometrics, kikoit aplikesheni ab visa ngung ak konunet kobo kowalut.
back_translation: Ndiyo. Timu yetu ya visa ilikuwa umepanga bima yako ya afya, ilifanya mtihani wa matibabu na biometrics, imehitimu ombi lako la visa na tuzo kuhusu matokeo.

english: Which countries can I study in?
Australia, New Zealand, Ireland and Germany, as well as the United Kingdom and Canada. A counsellor will help you choose.
kiswahili: Australia, New Zealand, Ayalandi na Ujerumani, pamoja na Uingereza na Kanada. Mshauri atakusaidia kuchagua.
translation: Australia, New Zealand, Ayalandi ak Ujerumani, ak Uingereza ak Kanada. Konetindet ko toreti kolewen.
back_translation: Australia, New Zealand, Holland, Germany, England na Canada. Mwalimu husaidia kuchagua.

kiswahili: Je, mnasaidia na safari za ndege?
translation: Tos tinyei Studies and Awards toretet eng ndegeshek?
back_translation: Je, Studa na Awards zina msaada wa ndege?

english: Yes. Through our partnership with Reserve Trip Kenya, our students can get discounted student air tickets.
kiswahili: Ndiyo. Kupitia ushirikiano wetu na Reserve Trip Kenya, wanafunzi wetu wanaweza kupata tiketi za ndege za wanafunzi kwa bei nafuu.
translation: Ee. Eng ak Reserve Trip Kenya, kipsomaninik nyonet imuch konyor tiketishek ab ndegeit eng olyet ne kararan.
back_translation: Naam, kwa Reserve Trip Kenya, wanafunzi wetu wanaweza kupata tiketi za ndege kwa bei ya juu.

english: Can I get help with school fees?
kiswahili: Je, naweza kupata msaada wa ada ya shule?
translation: Tos amuchi konyor toretet ab robinik ab sukul?
back_translation: Je, ninaweza kupata msaada wa karo?

english: Ask us about financial support through Magister Sacco.
kiswahili: Tuulize kuhusu msaada wa kifedha kupitia Magister Sacco.
translation: Tebut kityo eng toretet ab robinik eng Magister Sacco.
back_translation: Wanahukumiwa tu kwa msaada wa kifedha kutoka kwa Master Sacco.

english: Daima Towers, Mezzanine 1, Eldoret, adjacent to Marie Stopes Eldoret.
kiswahili: Daima Towers, Mezzanine 1, Eldoret, karibu na Marie Stopes Eldoret.
translation: Daima Towers, Mezzanine 1, Eldoret, nekit ak Marie Stopes Eldoret.
back_translation: Daima Towers, Mezzanine 1, Eldoret, karibu na Marie Stopes Eldoret.

english: Ready to start your journey abroad?
kiswahili: Uko tayari kuanza safari yako ughaibuni?

english: Visit our office at Daima Towers, Eldoret, or meet our team online.
kiswahili: Tembelea ofisi yetu Daima Towers, Eldoret, au kutana na timu yetu mtandaoni.
translation: Koi eng ofisit nyonet eng Daima Towers, Eldoret, anan kityo online.
back_translation: Ofisi yetu iko katika Daima Towers, Eldoret, au tu mtandaoni.

english: Personalised guidance from your first meeting with us until you arrive and start your studies abroad.
kiswahili: Mwongozo wa kibinafsi kuanzia mkutano wako wa kwanza nasi hadi unapofika na kuanza masomo yako ughaibuni.
translation: Toretet ne kararan kongete tuiyet ne kotau ak kityo koakoi ibun ak itau somanet ngung eng sang.
back_translation: Huduma bora kutoka kwa kikao cha kwanza kinaweza kuleta na kuanza masomo yako ya nje.
Blog hii ni ya kushangaza sana

english: on Google Maps (opens in a new tab)
kiswahili: kwenye Google Maps (hufunguka kwenye kichupo kipya)
translation: eng Google Maps (kiyat eng bukuit ne lel)
back_translation: kwenye Google Maps (lilifunguliwa katika kitabu kipya)

kiswahili: Tumefungwa wikendi na sikukuu za umma

english: Destination updates and intake deadlines, straight to your inbox.
kiswahili: Habari za nchi na tarehe za mwisho za kujiunga, moja kwa moja kwenye barua pepe yako.
translation: Ngalek ab emotinwek ak betushek ab konyet ab somanet, kobun eng baruet ngung.
back_translation: Kuhusu mataifa na nyakati za ujauzito, tafadhali wasiliana na barua yako.

english: Studies and Awards Limited. All rights reserved.
kiswahili: Studies and Awards Limited. Haki zote zimehifadhiwa.
translation: Studies and Awards Limited. Kimutyo tugul.
back_translation: Studies and Awards Limited. Halikudhuru mtu yeyote aliyemkopesha.

english: Studies and Awards Limited | Study Abroad Consultancy, Eldoret Kenya
kiswahili: Studies and Awards Limited | Ushauri wa Kusoma Nje ya Nchi, Eldoret Kenya
translation: Studies and Awards Limited | Ngalalet ab Somanet eng Sang, Eldoret Kenya
back_translation: Studies and Awards Limited wanachopanga Somo kutoka Sang, Eldoret Kenya.

english: One team with you from your first meeting to your visa.
kiswahili: Timu moja pamoja nawe kuanzia mkutano wa kwanza hadi visa yako.
translation: Timit age ak iyon kongete tuiyet ne taun koakoi visa ngung.
back_translation: Timu nyingine ya kuandaa tangu mkutano wa kwanza ni kuwasilisha visa vyako.

english: Every student goes through the same six steps with us, whichever of our six countries they choose. Each step has its own team in our office at Daima Towers, Eldoret, so you always know who is looking after you.
kiswahili: Kila mwanafunzi hupitia hatua zile zile sita nasi, awe amechagua nchi yoyote kati ya nchi zetu sita. Kila hatua ina timu yake katika ofisi yetu Daima Towers, Eldoret, ili ujue kila wakati ni nani anayekuhudumia.
translation: Kipsomaniat tugul ko iwendi hatua loo ne age ak kityo, koboto kole emet ne kilewen eng emotinwek nyonet ab loo. Hatua age age ko tinye timit nyin eng ofisit nyonet eng Daima Towers, Eldoret, kichobun chii ne toretun.
back_translation: Kila mwanafunzi huenda hatua kumi na moja tu, ikiwemo Uchaguzi wa Kitaifa katika nchi yetu ya kumi na moja. Hatua nyingine ni kwa timu yake katika ofisi yetu ya Daima Towers, Eldoret, iliyoundwa na msaidizi.

english: Visit our office at Daima Towers in Eldoret, or meet our team online from anywhere in Kenya. We talk through your grades, budget and goals, and help you choose the country, course and school that suit you. Every member of our team gives consultations, so whoever you meet first can get you started.
kiswahili: Tembelea ofisi yetu Daima Towers mjini Eldoret, au kutana na timu yetu mtandaoni popote nchini Kenya. Tunazungumzia alama zako, bajeti na malengo yako, na kukusaidia kuchagua nchi, kozi na shule zinazokufaa. Kila mwanachama wa timu yetu hutoa ushauri, kwa hivyo yeyote utakayekutana naye kwanza anaweza kukuanzisha.
translation: Koi eng ofisit nyonet eng Daima Towers eng Eldoret, anan kityo online eng Kenya tugul. Kingalal eng tiemutik ngung, bajetit ak panganet ngung, ak kitoretun lewen emet, kosit ak sukul ne kararan. Chii tugul ab timit nyonet ko ngalali, kou chii ne kityoi taun ko imuch itau ichi.
back_translation: Kumbe katika ofisi yetu ya Daima Towers, Eldoret, au labda mtandaoni kote Kenya. Wakati wa kuzungumza juu ya mitihani yako, bajeti na mipango yako, na jinsi ya kuchagua nchi, kozi na shule nzuri, kila mwanachama wa timu yetu anazungumza kama mwanachama aliye na mwanzo anaweza kujieleza.

kiswahili: Alama zako, bajeti na malengo yako
translation: Tiemutik ngung, bajetit ak panganet ngung
back_translation: Mitihani yako, bajeti na mpango wako

english: The countries, courses and schools that fit them
kiswahili: Nchi, kozi na shule zinazolingana nazo
translation: Emotinwek, kosit ak sukulisiek che kararan

english: Whether you have already sat IELTS elsewhere. If you have the score you need, you go straight to step 3.
kiswahili: Iwapo tayari ulifanya IELTS mahali pengine. Ukiwa na alama unazohitaji, unaruka moja kwa moja hadi hatua ya 3.
translation: Kole kasomanchi IELTS eng ole age. Kole itinye tiemutik ne imache, iwendi kwa moja eng hatua 3.
back_translation: Alisema amesoma IELTS mahali pengine. Ikiwa una mtihani unaotaka, nenda moja kwa moja hatua ya 3.

english: Any member of our team. Meet the team
kiswahili: Mwanachama yeyote wa timu yetu. Kutana na timu
translation: Chii tugul ab timit nyonet. Kityoi timit
back_translation: Alikuwa mwanachama wa timu yetu. Alikusanya timu

english: Witney prepares you for your English test, IELTS or PTE. If you are going to Germany, Karen teaches you German. Either way, you choose how you learn.
kiswahili: Witney anakuandaa kwa mtihani wako wa Kiingereza, IELTS au PTE. Ukienda Ujerumani, Karen anakufundisha Kijerumani. Kwa vyovyote vile, wewe huchagua jinsi ya kujifunza.
translation: Witney ko ineti tiemutik ab kutit tab chumbek, IELTS anan PTE. Kole iwendi Ujerumani, Karen ko ineti Kijerumani. Eng ole age, ilewen ole ne isomani.
back_translation: Witney anafundisha mtihani wa Kiingereza, IELTS au PTE. Alisema huenda Ujerumani, Karen anafundisha Kijerumani. Katika sehemu nyingine, kuchagua mahali pa kusoma.

english: In classAt Daima Towers, during the day
OnlineIn the evening, from wherever you are
When you are ready, we book your exam for you. If you don’t reach the score you need, you come back to class and we book your next attempt.
kiswahili: Ukiwa tayari, tunakuwekea mtihani wako. Usipofikia alama unazohitaji, unarudi darasani na tunakuwekea jaribio lako lijalo.
draft_not_used: Kole itinye, kitumi tiemutik ngung. Kole matinye tiemutik ne imache, iwendi kora eng sukul ak kitumi ne age.
back_translation: Alisema ana, alitumia mtihani wako. Alisema hana mitihani unayofaa, kisha utaenda shule na kitamu nyingine.

english: Already sat IELTS elsewhere with the score you need? Go straight to step 3
kiswahili: Tayari ulifanya IELTS mahali pengine na una alama unazohitaji? Nenda moja kwa moja hadi hatua ya 3
translation: Kasomanchi IELTS eng ole age ak itinye tiemutik ne imache? Wend kwa moja eng hatua 3
back_translation: Umesomea IELTS mahali pengine na una mtihani unaotaka? Nenda moja kwa moja katika hatua ya 3.

english: Rahab tells you exactly which documents your application needs, and keeps them safely on file once they are in. When your documents are complete and approved, she passes your file on to our compliance team.
kiswahili: Rahab anakuambia hasa nyaraka ambazo ombi lako linahitaji, na anazihifadhi salama zikishafika. Nyaraka zako zikikamilika na kuidhinishwa, anapitisha faili yako kwa timu yetu ya utiifu.
translation: Rahab ko kimwoch karatasishek ne imache eng aplikesheni ngung, ak koit kalyet kole kobun. Kole karatasishek ngung kokoit ak kokolewen, ko toret kole kwe timit nyonet ab konunet.
back_translation: Rahab alimwambia karatasi ulizotaka katika app yako, na amani ikaja. Akasema karatasi zako tayari zimefika na kumchagua, ni msaada wa timu yetu ya maadhimisho.

english: Each document certified by a lawyer
back_translation: Kila karatasi ni zawadi ya wakili

english: Canisius and Dennis check that every document you have given us is authentic, by confirming it with whoever issued it. Only once everything has been checked does your file move on to the application team.
